All three display preferences work. Refresh **http://maker:4001** and click **Settings** (top-right).

**Flow 15 — display preferences.** The Settings panel has three choices:
1. **Default sort** — pick e.g. **Title — A to Z.** The list reorders immediately, and this becomes the order the app **opens with** next time. (The Sort dropdown stays in sync.)
2. **Items shown per page** — choose a number (say **5**). The list then shows that many at a time with a **"Show more"** button revealing the next batch; picking **All** shows everything. (With only a handful of bookmarks you'll see "Show more" once you have more than the page size — add or import a few to watch it kick in.)
3. **Text size** — **Small / Medium / Large** adjusts the reading size of titles, descriptions and notes across the list. Try **Large.**
4. Click **Done** to close the panel.

Two decisions to confirm:
- **These are personal display preferences that apply across the whole app and stick** (default sort is also the startup order). Any change takes effect immediately. Right scope?
- **"Items per page" uses a "Show more" button** to reveal further batches (rather than numbered pages 1, 2, 3…). Is progressive "Show more" what you'd prefer, or numbered pages?

That's the last of your six additional blocks. After you're happy with this one, I'll do a quick edge-case pass over these new features, then bring the whole scope back for your go-ahead to build.
